counting_note: Matt's rule (28 Oct): buildings_counted counts a row of 3 to 5 joined houses as 1 (a longer row 1 for each 5), a larger house as 1, a small or medium free-standing house as 1 (each building counts_as); the big structures (keeps, temples, pagodas, towers, depots, stations, warehouses, halls) are landmarks, listed apart with their reason; fronts counts each front. The target is a guide: a little outside is a warning, beyond 25 % a fail

ground.Company district: wide composite slab paving in cell-aligned modules, light strips along the cell edges, flush tram and maglev tracks, planters
ground.the Lanes: narrow patched paving, cable runs, awnings and stalls
ground.docks: steel deck plates, crane rails, painted loading bays
ground.Heights: terraces, stairs and raised walks to the Skyport; the maglev on its viaduct
ground.green: only in planned pockets: the park, square trees, courtyard plants, roof gardens
ground.edges: mudflats and salt marsh at the delta, allotments and market gardens at Canalside, heath, scrub and dunes on the Cape Road; bare rock and concrete apron at the cape
